bounded_pilot.conclusion_limit: A matched fault and target throw would be a bounded causal pilot observation; it is not a new-bug claim or full-campaign result.
bounded_pilot.fault_scope: Only the explicit @563 sendHeartbeat call before invocation, on the same BPServiceActor, DataNode, and epoch; no other doors.
bounded_pilot.one_fault_condition: One scheduled heartbeat after NN rotation R1 is skipped; no successful key-update heartbeat reaches this DN before NN rotation R2 promotes the new key, token mint, and selected DN lookup.
bounded_pilot.required_observation: For one token identifier digest, bpid and keyId k: R1 NN next-key insertion, pending true with DN UUID, H1 selected fault, R2 promotion, H2 next attempt on same actor/epoch, NN mint after R2, valid selected DN lookup before any DN addKeys(k), exact branch/throw, and strict root-free graph path. Two-fault mode faults H1 and H2 only.
stop_conditions: JUnit zero tests, failure, error, or timeout unrelated to the selected check
unknown or conflicting actor/epoch, keyId, block-pool ID, or test-method identity
successful addKeys(k) before the selected lookup or no R1-to-R2 promotion window
target not reached, only an expired-token rejection, or root/coarse/timeline-only path
any unselected fault or more than the bounded trial count
bounded_pilot.two_fault_condition: Only after the one-fault observations show a successful intervening update; skip the first two scheduled heartbeats after R1 on that same actor and epoch, then require R2/token/target ordering before the next successful update.

current_instrumentation_limits: Pinned heartbeat-v1 runtime JARs do not contain the new HDFS12_KEY metadata hooks; current healthy config remains source-only diagnostic until a scoped release replaces them.
state.maps captures map key/object and sampled version but not Map.get return or Iterator.remove; selected branch supplies null/non-null result.
A before-call heartbeat fault delays delivery; no response token exists for an RPC that never reached the NN.
The source overlay selectors passed offline pinned-class checks, but no live transformer/JUnit/graph identity has been tested.
healthy_required: Exactly one executed and passing JUnit method TestEncryptedTransfer.testLongLivedClient[0]; zero or different tests reject.
New HDFS-12 agent and adapter overlay compiled, tested, immutable and SHA-pinned; pinned Hadoop class images and exact selected door catalogued.
Named DataNode/epoch selected nonthrowing @511 branch, no selected @514 throw, same-thread/context selected HDFS12_KEY dn_lookup and STATE_READ.
NN nn_token_mint and DN dn_lookup have identical nonempty SHA-256 token identifier digest, bpid, keyId, and expiry; expiry exceeds lookup wall time.
NN descriptor UUID joins a unique DN dn_bind named actor/epoch; nn_command_key matches that bpid/keyId/peer, and dn_add_keys matches that named DN/epoch.
Strict root-free event-time graph paths nn_command_key→dn_add_keys→selected target, including the state handoff; timeline proximity alone is insufficient.
No unknown actor, epoch, token digest, keyId, block-pool ID, ambiguous test method, trace truncation, or local timeline doors.
pilot_admission: prohibited until every healthy_required item is attested on one pinned run and dispatch grants an idle HDFS lane

source_model.command: A successful NN heartbeat with needKeyUpdate true adds KeyUpdateCommand and clears the flag; the DN command processor subsequently calls addKeys. The pre-call fault does not clear needKeyUpdate.
source_model.heartbeat: The DN default heartbeat interval is 3000 ms. sendHeartBeat schedules the next heartbeat before the selected RPC call. An injected pre-call IOException skips this scheduled attempt, offerService catches it, sleeps at most 1000 ms, and retries when the next heartbeat is due.
source_model.registration_keys: DN registration imports NN current and next block keys; the next key can validate the first promotion without a new command.
source_model.rotation: The NN HeartbeatManager checks every 5000 ms; with the test's 2000 ms key-update interval, successive monitor passes can promote a previously exported next key and create a new next key.
source_model.target: retrievePassword first rejects expired tokens, then looks up identifier.keyId in the DN allKeys map. Missing-key evidence requires a still-valid token at this exact lookup.

source_only_overlay.adapter_dependency: scoped HdfsMiniClusterTransformer/HdfsHooks/Hdfs12KeyHooks; requires new isolated adapter release
source_only_overlay.agent_dependency: scoped Probe.blockKeyObservation API; requires new isolated agent release
source_only_overlay.token_id: SHA-256 of BlockTokenIdentifier.getBytes, no identifier or key bytes emitted
